scope: 1000 available dbo CSV files; may not represent the complete live SQL catalog

stages.limitation: ليس تحليلًا لدلالات الأعمدة أو للمحتوى
وجود الجدول لا يثبت صحة بياناته

stages.measurement: independently validated business meaning and provenance per table
stages.limitation: غير مقاس؛ يمنع عرض نسبة إكمال مصطنعة

stages.measurement: live SQL authenticated read-only tests with backend isolation
stages.limitation: لا يوجد جسر SQL إنتاجي مثبت لهذا التطبيق

audit_catalog.public_content: metadata count only; no field names, row IDs or financial values

acceptance: Each table must have field definitions and document-level source validation
Critical keys and history joins require row-level evidence and no false orphan conclusions
Business and tax rules require signed-off scope and test cases
JAWAFA ONE screens must be tested with authorized data while financial records remain immutable
Live SQL reader must be verified with least privilege and private authenticated gateway
No production 90% declaration without independent review and evidence hashes

relationships.label: POS sales header ⇄ item lines

relationships.label: Receipt ⇄ RecLine

analysis_scope: Every one of 17 priority CSV tables had its rows counted and six inferred join checks executed. No live SQL foreign-key metadata was used.
